class.name: EGPBox2DWorld
class.brief_description: Explicit fixed-tick Box2D simulation with stable entity identifiers, every Box2D feature and local rollback.
class.description: The 2D counterpart of [EGPBox3DWorld]. Owns a Box2D world independent of the scene physics server: call [method configure], queue commands, then call [method step_tick] once per simulation tick. Commands execute in entity ID and sequence order; world commands run after body commands, joints after both. Use one constructing thread for every call. Every Box2D feature is available through Dictionaries of named fields: bodies with any number of circle, capsule, box, polygon, segment and chain shapes and their materials, filters and events; every joint type; forces, torques, impulses and wind; world settings and explosions. Readback, per-step events and queries map Box2D shapes back to entity and shape index. Snapshots restore in place and keep every identity. They hold solver state for trusted local history on a compatible build only; never restore bytes received from a peer.

method.name: apply_queued_commands
method.description: Validates the entire sorted batch, then applies it without advancing the tick. Use for a baseline or an authoritative correction before capturing a snapshot.

method.name: capture_snapshot
method.description: Captures the Box2D world image and the identity tables at a boundary with no queued commands. Bounded to 64 MiB; empty on failure.

method.name: cast_rays
method.description: Closest hit per ray as parallel arrays: [code]hit[/code], [code]fraction[/code], [code]point[/code], [code]normal[/code], [code]entity[/code], [code]shape[/code]. [param mask] filters by shape category.

method.name: cast_shape
method.description: Sweeps a circle, capsule, box, polygon or segment along [param translation] and returns the closest hit ([code]hit[/code], [code]fraction[/code], [code]point[/code], [code]normal[/code], [code]entity[/code], [code skip-lint]shape[/code]); equal fractions resolve by identity.

method.name: clear_pending_commands
method.description: Clears a rejected or cancelled batch.

method.name: configure
method.description: Creates the Box2D world once. Lengths are in Box2D length units, which EGP sets to [code]physics/box_2d/pixels_per_meter[/code] for the whole process, so worlds use the same pixel scale as 2D scenes (the default gravity is Godot's 980 pixels per second squared, Y down). The units are part of [method get_simulation_fingerprint] and of snapshots. Worker counts above 1 run solver tasks on the engine [WorkerThreadPool]; results do not depend on scheduling.

method.name: get_body
method.description: Reads every body field plus [code]world_center_of_mass[/code], [code]shape_count[/code], [code]joint_count[/code] and [code]shapes[/code] (the shape indices). Empty for an unknown body.

method.name: get_body_count
method.description: The number of bodies.

method.name: get_body_states
method.description: Six floats per body: position xy, angle, linear velocity xy, angular velocity. Unknown bodies read as NaN.

method.name: get_entities
method.description: Every body entity, ascending.

method.name: get_events
method.description: Box2D events of the latest [method step_tick], with the same keys as [method EGPBox3DWorld.get_events]: shape pairs flattened as entity A, shape A, entity B, shape B ([code]contact_begin[/code], [code]contact_end[/code], [code]sensor_begin[/code], [code]sensor_end[/code], [code]contact_hit[/code] with [code]contact_hit_point[/code], [code]contact_hit_normal[/code] and [code]contact_hit_speed[/code]); [code]moved[/code] with [code]moved_transforms[/code] (3 floats each: position xy, angle); [code]fell_asleep[/code]; [code]joint_threshold[/code].

method.name: get_field_names
method.description: Every field of a set ([code]"world"[/code], [code]"body"[/code], [code]"shape"[/code] or [code]"joint"[/code]) mapped to its [enum Variant.Type].

method.name: get_joint
method.description: Reads the joint's [code]type[/code], [code]body_a[/code], [code]body_b[/code], frames, tuning, type fields and state: [code]constraint_force[/code], [code]constraint_torque[/code], [code]linear_separation[/code], [code]angular_separation[/code] and, by type, [code]angle[/code], [code]translation[/code], [code]speed[/code], [code]current_length[/code], [code]motor_torque[/code], [code]motor_force[/code].

method.name: get_joint_count
method.description: The number of joints.

method.name: get_joint_ids
method.description: Every joint identifier, ascending.

method.name: get_shape
method.description: Reads shape material, density, filter, sensor and event flags and bounds. A chain reads as its first segment plus [code]segment_count[/code] and, with per-point materials, [code]materials[/code]. Every field is range-checked when queued (Box2D's non-negative materials, damping, stiffness, motors and thresholds, positive lengths, revolute limits within 0.99 PI, ordered lower/upper pairs).

method.name: get_simulation_fingerprint
method.description: Solver revision, numeric profile, tick rate, substeps and configured gravity.

method.name: get_state_hash
method.description: Diagnostic hash of tick, settings, stable ids, poses, velocities and joint forces.

method.name: get_tick
method.description: The last completed tick.

method.name: get_world
method.description: Reads world settings and counters ([code]awake_body_count[/code], [code]body_count[/code], [code]shape_count[/code], [code]contact_count[/code], [code]joint_count[/code], [code]island_count[/code], [code]bounds_lower[/code], [code]bounds_upper[/code], [code]tick[/code]), including [code]contact_hertz[/code], [code]contact_damping_ratio[/code], [code]contact_speed[/code] and [code]speculative[/code].

method.name: move_capsule
method.description: Box2D character mover: collides, solves planes and sweeps a capsule ([param point_a] to [param point_b] around [param position]) through shapes matching [param mask]. Returns [code skip-lint]position[/code] and [code]clipped[/code] (the translation clipped by the contact planes). Give the character's own body a category outside [param mask].

method.name: overlap_aabb
method.description: Shapes whose bounds overlap the box, as entity and shape index pairs sorted by identity.

method.name: overlap_shape
method.description: Shapes overlapping a circle, capsule, box, polygon or segment placed at [param position] and [param angle], as entity and shape index pairs sorted by identity.

method.name: queue_add_shape
method.description: Attaches a shape (same Dictionary as [method queue_create_body]) at an unused [param shape_index] below 256. Shape indices are the stable identities used by events and queries, and they survive snapshots. All segments of a chain share its index.

method.name: queue_apply
method.description: Applies a force (acting over the next step), torque or impulse. Linear kinds use [param value]; [constant APPLY_TORQUE] and [constant APPLY_ANGULAR_IMPULSE] use [param scalar]; [param point] is the world point for [constant APPLY_FORCE_AT_POINT] and [constant APPLY_IMPULSE_AT_POINT].

method.name: queue_apply_wind
method.description: Applies Box2D's aerodynamic wind to one shape with drag and lift coefficients (for example leaves, flags or sails).

method.name: queue_create_body
method.description: Creates a body from any Box2D body fields (see [method get_field_names] with [code]"body"[/code]) and attaches [param shapes] as shape indices 0, 1, 2 and so on. [code]type[/code] accepts [code]"static"[/code], [code]"kinematic"[/code], [code]"dynamic"[/code] or 0-2; [code]rotation[/code] is an angle in radians. [code]fast_rotation[/code] applies at creation only. Each shape is a [Dictionary] with a [code]type[/code] ([code]"circle"[/code], [code]"capsule"[/code], [code]"box"[/code], [code]"polygon"[/code], [code]"segment"[/code], [code]"chain"[/code]), geometry keys and any shape fields ([code]friction[/code], [code]restitution[/code], [code]rolling_resistance[/code], [code]tangent_speed[/code], [code]density[/code], [code]category[/code], [code]mask[/code], [code]group[/code], [code]sensor[/code], [code]contact_events[/code] and so on). Geometry keys: [code]radius[/code] (circle, capsule, or rounding of box and polygon), [code]center[/code] and [code]angle[/code] (local placement), [code]half_height[/code] or [code]point_a[/code]/[code]point_b[/code] (capsule, segment), [code]half_extents[/code] (box), [code]points[/code] (polygon hull of up to 8 points; chain points) and [code]materials[/code] (chains: an [Array] with one material Dictionary per segment: points for a loop, points minus 3 for an open chain), [code]loop[/code] (chains are one-sided segments from 4 points or more; an open chain's first and last points are ghost vertices). [codeblock] world.queue_create_body(3, 0, {"type": "dynamic", "position": Vector2(0, 4), "bullet": true}, [{"type": "capsule", "radius": 0.3, "half_height": 0.5, "friction": 0.2}, {"type": "box", "half_extents": Vector2(0.2, 0.1), "center": Vector2(0, 0.9), "angle": 0.3}]) [/codeblock]

method.name: queue_destroy_body
method.description: Destroys a body with its shapes and the joints attached to it.

method.name: queue_destroy_joint
method.description: Destroys a joint and wakes its bodies.

method.name: queue_destroy_shape
method.description: Removes one shape or chain and updates the body's mass.

method.name: queue_explode
method.description: Box2D explosion pushing shapes whose category matches [param mask] within [param radius] (plus [param falloff]) of [param position].

method.name: queue_joint
method.description: Creates any Box2D joint: [code]"distance"[/code], [code]"filter"[/code], [code]"motor"[/code], [code]"prismatic"[/code], [code]"revolute"[/code], [code]"weld"[/code] or [code]"wheel"[/code]. Common fields: [code]anchor_a[/code], [code]rotation_a[/code], [code]anchor_b[/code], [code]rotation_b[/code] (body-local frames; prismatic and wheel joints slide along the frame's X axis), [code]collide_connected[/code], [code]force_threshold[/code], [code]torque_threshold[/code], [code]constraint_hertz[/code], [code]constraint_damping_ratio[/code]. Type fields use Box2D's names in snake case, for example [code]length[/code], [code]enable_spring[/code], [code]hertz[/code], [code]enable_limit[/code], [code]lower_angle[/code], [code]enable_motor[/code], [code]motor_speed[/code], [code]max_motor_torque[/code], [code]lower_translation[/code]. Joints are created after the batch's body commands.

method.name: queue_set_body
method.description: Changes body fields through Box2D's runtime setters: type, transform, velocities, damping, gravity scale, motion locks, sleep, bullet, enabled, mass data, contact and hit events, and [code]target_position[/code]/[code]target_rotation[/code] (a kinematic move reaching the target in [code]target_time[/code], one tick by default).

method.name: queue_set_joint
method.description: Changes joint fields through Box2D's runtime setters. Applied after joint creation in the same batch.

method.name: queue_set_shape
method.description: Changes shape fields: surface material, [code]density[/code] (with [code]update_body_mass[/code]), filter ([code]category[/code], [code]mask[/code], [code]group[/code]) and event flags. On a chain, material applies to every segment material and filter and events to every segment; with [param material_index] 0 or above only that entry of the chain's material table changes.

method.name: queue_set_world
method.description: Changes world settings: [code]gravity[/code], [code]restitution_threshold[/code], [code]hit_event_threshold[/code], [code]maximum_linear_speed[/code], [code]sleep[/code], [code]continuous[/code], [code]warm_starting[/code], [code]speculative[/code], [code]contact_recycle_distance[/code], and [code]contact_hertz[/code], [code]contact_damping_ratio[/code] and [code]contact_speed[/code]. World commands run after the batch's body commands and are part of snapshots.

method.name: restore_snapshot
method.description: Restores a snapshot of this build and profile in place: ids, events and identities are rebuilt and the tick returns to the snapshot's. Only restore trusted local history.

method.name: step_tick
method.description: Applies queued commands in entity and sequence order, then steps exactly one tick. [param expected_tick] must be the next tick.

constants.constant: Force at the centre of mass, acting over the next step.
Force at a world point, acting over the next step.
Torque, acting over the next step.
Linear impulse at the centre of mass.
Linear impulse at a world point.
